path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.

format.description: Explicit interpretation: dos-com or raw-binary (headerless), or gamecube-dol (GameCube/Wii DOL, never auto-detected). Omission preserves header-based detection.

architecture.description: Caller-supplied CPU family. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. format=gamecube-dol takes powerpc from the header, so it must be omitted.

entry_point.description: Caller-supplied load and entry address (0xhex). File offset 0 is mapped here. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. Optional with format=gamecube-dol; must equal the DOL header entry.

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

open_binary.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the exported evidence bundle; relative paths are rejected.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced.

export_evidence_bundle.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.
